scripts.test:all: bash -c 'npm run test & P1=$!; npm run test:bun & P2=$!; wait $P1; R1=$?; wait $P2; R2=$?; exit $((R1|R2))'
scripts.coverage: tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && c8 --src=src --all --exclude 'src/benchmarks/**' --exclude 'src/**/*.ts' --report --reporter html --reporter text --per-file --skip-full --check-coverage --branches 100 --statements 100 --functions 100 --lines 100 -- node --test 'src/tests/*.test.js'
scripts.coverage:all: bash -c 'npm run coverage & P1=$!; npm run coverage:bun & P2=$!; wait $P1; R1=$?; wait $P2; R2=$?; exit $((R1|R2))'
scripts.prepare: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.json && npm run lint && oxfmt --check 'src/**/*.ts' '!src/**/*.d.ts' && npm run coverage:all
